intro: Cape Verde has ten volcanic islands about 570 km off West Africa.

chapters.title: Islands
text: Fogo has an active volcano, Pico do Fogo, the highest point at 2,829 m. Sal and Boa Vista are flat with long beaches; Santo Antão is green and mountainous.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The islands are dry, with little rain, and dusty harmattan winds.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Cape Verde's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
